messages.text: Does the freeport 16 desktop rotate and tilt
Searched the catalog · Replogle Freeport 16 Antique Ocean Raised Relief Globe

The Freeport 16" is a desktop globe mounted on a die-cast metal meridian with a cherry-finish hardwood base, so it does rotate on its axis, but its description doesn't mention a tilting or full-swing meridian the way some other models do — so I can't confirm it tilts.

If tilt matters to you (say, for viewing the poles easily), the Eureka 16" Antique Ocean Globe you're also looking at has a full-swing gyromatic metal meridian that lets you both tilt and rotate the sphere to any angle, including the poles. Would that kind of full-tilt viewing be important for how you plan to use it?
